title: Fixed Sliding Jaw and Thumbwheel Adjustable Wrench
description: One newly authored whole static adjustable-wrench appearance. A continuous long tapered handle and broad fixed-jaw head include a real end hanging hole and an actual through-window below the jaw. A separate whole sliding-jaw appearance has a long transverse stem captured within the fixed head channel and a tall opposed flat jaw in one fixed open pose. A supported transverse axle carries one whole annular-ridged thumbwheel visible through the head window. A short dark inset handle pad leaves the end hole unobstructed. All finite geometry newly authored, no old fixed open-jaw wrench isolated from a wall kit. One prop, zero scenes, three opaque materials. No moving adjustment, helical gear engagement, calibrated jaw opening, torque, gripping capacity, operating guidance or safety claim.
